schema.notices:
CREATE TABLE notices (
  notice_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  job_id TEXT REFERENCES jobs(job_id),
  session_id TEXT,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','offered','acknowledged','surfaced')),
  transport TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  offered_at TEXT,
  acknowledged_at TEXT,
  wake_state TEXT CHECK (wake_state IS NULL OR wake_state IN ('claimed','delivered','undeliverable','stale')),
  wake_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  wake_next_at REAL,
  wake_at REAL,
  wake_reason TEXT
)
schema.caller_wake_sessions:
CREATE TABLE caller_wake_sessions (
  session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  active_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  last_wake_at REAL
)
schema.notices_caller_wake:
CREATE INDEX notices_caller_wake ON notices(created_at, notice_id)
  WHERE job_id IS NOT NULL AND state='pending' AND wake_state IS NULL
